name: Night shift nurse
source:
There’s a rumour about an abandoned hospital; it sounds like a good place to explore at night, but once inside there’s something strange about it. While the entrance might look destroyed, the inside looks intact, as if it’s not abandoned. What is going on?

[From [url=https://corrocerous.itch.io/night-shift-nurse]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
有传言说有一所废弃的医院；这听起来像是一个夜间探索的好地方，但一旦进去，就会发现一些奇怪的东西。虽然入口看起来可能被毁坏了，但内部看起来完好无损，就好像它没有被遗弃一样。到底是怎么回事？

[来自[url=https://corrocerous.itch.io/night-shift-nurse]itch.io[/url]]
